name: Bible API
description: Free, open-source, static Bible API. The entire KJV (1611) is available as plain JSON files served straight from a CDN — no API keys, no rate limits, no server.
notes: A single verse is selected client-side from its chapter file: chapter.verses.find(v => v.verse === n).
Book identifiers are lowercase slugs, e.g. 'genesis', '1-corinthians', 'song-of-solomon'.
Chapter and verse numbers are integers.
Versions: kjv (66 books) and kjv1611 (80 books, original 1611 spelling plus Apocrypha).
